CutScene.Text: Little more could be learned of Aravein or her whereabouts, so the most obvious course seemed to be to learn about the Sundering instead.
There were few creatures still alive in Etheria who had witnessed the event, except the most ancient of Dragons.
To approach them without the most princely of gifts would be certain death – even for younger Dragons. Yet the knowledge they could impart would be worth the risk.
There was one gift certain to gain favor – an item known as the Dragonstone. It had long been lost to them, and had come into possession of the Sirian Knights.
The Knights would never be persuaded to part with it; it was a sacred relic to them, having helped them win the Bane-wars many years ago.
It would need to be taken by force.
